{{Youmay|the MSF mouse droid|the [[MSE-series]] mouse droids}}{{Image}}The '''MSF mouse droid''', also known as the '''MSF-series''', was a line of wheeled messenger droids manufactured by the [[X2-4]] plant on [[Uffel]].

==Characteristics==
The droids were a variant on the [[MSE-series]] mouse droid, but modified to perform minor technical repairs as well as to hover on tiny [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines. They were equipped with a recording unit for both audio and visual data, two tool mounts, two telescoping arms and an internal [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. The droids were cheap, friendly and utilitarian. It was a very popular droid, especially in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and it was financially successful for the droids of Uffel.<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> At one time, having one or two MSF droids was a sign of affluence.<ref name="Uffel">{{LivingForce|Broken Orbits: Something Uffel}}</ref>

==History==
The MSF-series was designed by droid entrepreneur [[QS-2D]], who managed the droid factories in Uffel. QS-2D decided to commercialize new droid designs when the initial mining operation of Uffel stopped being profitable, and its MSF design gave it a lot of popularity&mdash;however, to avoid attention towards the "independent droid," QS-2D maintained that it was still working for an organic, but reclusive, master. QS-2D also kept for itself the prototype of the design, [[MSF-F2]].<ref name="LFCG" />

Production of the MSF line was temporarily shut down after a debris storm,<ref name="No Droids for You!">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20010927a_uffel&c=swlfc|text=No Droids for You!}}</ref> but eventually restarted after a sabotage attempt was foiled by a group of heroes from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Following the incident, the MSF-series droid [[MSF-111]] became attached to one of the heroes and left Uffel in their company.<ref name="Uffel" />
